interfaces.what: LGA-14L body 2.5000 x 3.0000 x 0.8300 mm, 14 lands, ECOPACK2. The frame is the package's geometric centre ON THE SEATING PLANE (z = 0 is the PCB land plane, +z into the body), which is the datum an SMT placement uses. TWO THINGS THIS ROW DOES NOT CLAIM, because the source does not carry them: the LAND GRID ITSELF (pad size, pitch and the pin-1 datum) is not in the vendor page this row cites, so it is CANNOT DETERMINE here — what settles it is the mechanical drawing in ST's own datasheet DS13510, section 'Package information', which the folder's PROVENANCE.json says was fetched on 2026-09-02 but which is NOT on disk in this folder today; and the BOARD this chip sits on, Pollen's imu_to_dxl v2, is unpublished, so how the package is oriented on it is unknown. `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN PRODUCT PAGE: STMicroelectronics LSM6DSV16X product page https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/lsm6dsv16x.html, package line 'LGA 14L' and 'ECOPACK2', dimensions '2.5 mm x 3 mm x 0.83 mm', fetched 2026-09-02 (lane T). This is the vendor's own page and not a distributor's transcription; it is a WEAKER source than the mechanical drawing in DS13510, which is what would carry the land grid, and the row says so.
